key_result: For U.S. equities the estimated maximal annualised Sharpe ratio is about 7.4, or 5.0 excluding micro-caps, against 1.0 to 4.0 for portfolio-based benchmarks.
takeaway: Estimates the maximum attainable Sharpe ratio in large cross-sections of assets directly, without building the efficient portfolio.
title: The Hidden Sharpe Ratio
why_it_matters: It shows that ridge-regularised Markowitz portfolios fall short of the true maximum by an explicit factor.
